Notch Interpolation Check

Broadband FOOOF (1–140 Hz, knee mode) on three despicable_me_english recordings, fitted on the raw notch-filtered Welch spectrum and on the same spectrum with the notch dips interpolated. Produced by extract_fooof_broadband_interp.py and examine_notch_interp.py, 2026-09-15.

raw (notched) spectruminterpolated spectrum

Detection. Per recording, the channel-median Welch spectrum (2 s segments, 0.5 Hz bins) is compared with a local log-log line fitted to bins 3–8 Hz away; bins more than 0.5 log10 below it, above 20 Hz, are notch bins. Contiguous bins form one notch.

Interpolation. Each notch is replaced over centre ± 3 Hz by a straight line in log-log space between the means of the 3 bins immediately outside the range on each side. Applied to every 10 s window before fitting.

Fit. Same window grid as Tier 2 (10 s / 2.5 s step), knee aperiodic mode, peak cap 8, peak width 1–10 Hz.
